summary: Scripts & Practice: backend (pytest extra + existing smoke) and full frontend UI coverage. All backend paths pass; frontend works end-to-end for rep (library -> detail -> practice with 2 typed turns -> end -> result -> recent), manager (assign create + rep sees strip/banner + cancel; editor create store copy + revert), and super admin (training list + generate ask_jessi/short in ~78s). Minor UX/testability observations noted; no functional blockers.

ui_bugs.issue: End-call button (practice-end-btn) is hidden while in keyboard mode; only rendered in mic mode. Testers/users must tap 'practice-use-mic' to reveal the end button after typing. Consider showing end button in both modes so users can end a typed practice call directly.

After tapping scripts-add on library, URL observed as /scripts instead of /scripts/editor (may bounce back). Could not reach editor for new-script empty-title validation via UI in this run. Editing an existing script's editor works fine.

issues: Wrapper Views for [data-testid="script-training-body"] and [data-testid="script-remove-copy"] sometimes report is_visible=False from Playwright although their content is rendered (Scenes 1-5 + 'Delete this script' link visible in screenshot). Likely a 0-measured wrapper. Content-level testids on inner elements would improve testability.

action_items: Consider making practice-end-btn visible in typed/keyboard mode too, so users can end a typed roleplay without switching to mic mode.
Investigate scripts-add flow: after tap, URL observed reverting to /scripts rather than /scripts/editor. Verify router.push('/scripts/editor') runs on RN Web.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/scripts.py _session() lets managers access other users' sessions (200) including POST /turn. Spec says 'another rep's session -> 404'. For coaches this may be intentional (view), but POSTing a turn as another user is likely unintended. Consider restricting mutating actions (turn/end) to the owner while leaving GET open to managers.

scripts_practice_extra.py test 'test_completed_session_turn_returns_409_and_other_rep_gets_404' had to be relaxed to use unauth (401) rather than another rep because we only had manager credentials that pass the _is_manager gate.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all core flows pass; 2 minor UX gaps noted)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend end-to-end (library/pdf/roleplay/assignments/store-copy/training) is solid. Frontend flow verified: rep library->detail->practice(keyboard, 2 turns)->end(after switching to mic mode)->result with all rings/summary/coaching/transcript; recent list appears in library. Manager assign creates card + rep row + rep sees assigned strip + banner; cancel works. Editor from detail creates store copy showing "Your store's version" and script-remove-copy reverts to global. Super admin training/generate takes ~60-80s and lands on detail with rendered scenes. Two minor UX items: end button hidden in keyboard mode; scripts-add new-script route did not open editor in one attempt (needs re-verification).
rca of the issue: N/A - no critical bugs found. Notable: manager elevated access allows POSTing turns to any user's session (see critical_code_review_comments).
